response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs, SUM(g.n) AS total_count, AVG(g.avg_bw - m.mean_avg) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg

assumptions.assumption: The count for each phase is the number of matched telescopes in that phase (COUNT(*)), including telescopes whose bandusagepct is NULL.

The mean of all phase averages is the unweighted mean of the per-phase averages. A NULL lunarstage forms its own group. A group whose averages are all NULL has a NULL average, so it is excluded from the mean and from the kept phases.
The join is an inner join on observstation, which drops unmatched telescopes. Values are not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: The count per phase includes only telescopes with a non-missing bandusagepct, i.e. the rows that went into the average.
